subject.title: fix(auto-reply): hide recovered failed tool progress

question: Should regular verbose mode change from always showing tool-failure summaries to hiding failures that are followed by a confirmed successful visible reply?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but current documentation defines visible failure summaries and the canonical issue leaves the default-versus-configurable policy unresolved.

options.title: Keep current default
options.body: Close this PR and retain visible failure summaries until the canonical issue establishes a different supported policy.

options.title: Sponsor recovery-aware hiding
options.body: Approve this behavior as the new default, then reopen or refresh the PR with documentation and exact-head channel validation.

options.title: Design an explicit setting
options.body: Keep the existing default and pursue a narrowly justified configuration only if the repository's high config-surface bar is met.

recommendation.title: Keep current default
recommendation.body: Close this PR and retain visible failure summaries until the canonical issue establishes a different supported policy.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest merged history across the shared auto-reply routing and progress-delivery surface and is best positioned to decide the default UX.
